title: Ramsays bolt a plaque to the mesa

tellings.quote: So, in 2007, Suzanne and Scott fixed the record themselves by bolting a plaque to the mesa, signed and dated.

plain: Michels says that in 2007 a couple named Scott and Suzanne Ramsey "fixed the record themselves" by bolting a signed and dated plaque to a mesa in Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, the place where, according to the story he is telling, a craft crashed with sixteen alien bodies aboard. Michels tells it himself as part of that story, and the plaque is his example of the couple marking the site because no one official would.
